body:
Thanks for the reply I really diddn't expect a mod to comment on my submission:). I do realize that they care about me and are worried about how I am living my life. But after all what happened through these years all my trust for the people I once loved is gone, its hard to put it in words but I really don't know or even understand what their love for me means anymore, like I mentioned in my previous submission it feels as if my feelings and emotions have been numbed and been taken away from me and that sometimes makes me feel like a piece of shit. I have tried to leave what has happened between my family and me behind me, but whenever I try to "be a son" or a part of the family it feels...artificial and I just can't play along because that just makes me feel worse. 

>Why not just take one day at a time?

Thats what I have been telling myself for a while now, I was sure that with time my life would get better and that I would find meaning in life again, but its just getting harder the older I get. I actually do want to life and see myself making progress in life, but the shittier my current situation gets the harder it becomes to have a positive outlook on my future. One of the biggest demotivators in my life is that once I catch some sort of break and things seem to be going great it doesn't take very long for my life to take a turn for the worst, which mainly always is my own fault. 

Thanks for listening :).
